published.title: Caleb Receives Hebron
published.summary: Caleb reminds Joshua of his faithful report as a spy and the promise Moses made to him. At eighty-five he asks for the hill country where the Anakims live, and Joshua blesses him and gives him Hebron as his inheritance.
